evidence.limits: No transcript yet; speech is coded from burned-in captions (4 fps to 5 s, 1 fps afterwards so some words are missed). The destination is never shown or named; the final shots are a plane window view of a green coastal plain, inferred to be the return to Israel only from the Hebrew ('ואני ממליץ לכם לעקוב'), not confirmed. The second 'trip' framing is read from the caption. Sound effects not determinable. Speech fields checked against the transcript on 09 Nov 2026 (text-only pass).

topic_detail: Mystery trip: he decided to fly alone to a country he always wanted to visit (destination not revealed), with airport and plane shots; the offer is a ₪1,000 prize for the follower who guesses and an invitation to follow the account.
audience: His followers, Instagram users who like guessing games and giveaways, Israeli travel fans.
caption_vs_video_note: Matches: the caption 'נחשו לאן טסתי' is the same game as the video. The video also contains the prize (₪1,000) and the follow request, which the caption does not mention.

opening.s0_1: Caption 'אז החלטתי שאני' builds word by word with a white highlight box moving word to word; he looks at the camera.
opening.s1_3: 'טס לבד למדינה' (1.0 s); at 1.7 s hard cut to a hand pulling a dark suitcase, caption 'שתמיד רציתי'; at 2.6 s cut to the 'ENTRANCE 32 / כניסה' sign.
opening.s3_5: 'לבקר בה והמקום' over the departures entrance (3.5 s), a ceiling sign 'לכל השערים' at 4.25 s with 'הזה הוא כל כך מיוחד שהייתי'. Speech: 'the place is so special I needed three different flights' (machine transcript, 3.5-7.8 s).
opening.visual_hook: Selfie with a passport at the airport, then rapid POV shots (suitcase, terminal signs).
opening.spoken_hook: Spoken from 0 s (machine transcript): 'אז החלטתי שאני טס לבד למדינה שתמיד רציתי לבקר בה'; speech is a voiceover over cuts.

story.payoff: None: the destination is not given in the video.
story.resolution: A prize for the right answer and a request to follow.
story.payoff_delivered: no: by design the destination is withheld

engagement.comment_notes: Sample of 42, not representative; about 40 are one-word destination guesses ('יפן', 'אוסטרליה', 'פרו'); two are jokes ('איך אבל אתה שכיר', 'בילבולי בצים'). The Reel has 1,367 comments in total (5.5 per 1k views), the highest comment rate among the Reels coded so far.

conversion.offer: ₪1,000 for the first follower to guess the country (a caption in the video: 'יזכה ב-₪1,000', first guesser of the right answer).
conversion.benefit: A chance at money; seeing the content from the trip.

conversion.cta_fits_content: yes: the game and follow request are the point of the video.

rights_and_privacy: Own footage; airline brand and menu elements visible; identifiable airport staff and a flight attendant and passengers appear without blur (yes); no minors seen.
why_it_may_work: Interpretation: an open question (where?) with a cash prize turns viewers into commenters, and the one-word guess is the easiest possible comment; the comment rate (5.5 per 1k views) is much higher than the rest of the set. Fast cuts and a first-frame passport make the trip clear at once.
why_it_may_underperform: Interpretation: no payoff in the video itself and few shares (none in the dossier).

Plane window over a city with 'תצליחו אחד מכם יזכה ב-₪1,000', the prize line.
